podcast.title: Teenage Years and Coming Out
podcast.body: As a teenager, Tom Robinson was sent to a special home for maladjusted boys. It was there, among similar maladjusted peers, that he was able to come out. "When he was a teenager, he was sent to a special home for maladjusted boys. Turns out that there were similar maladjusted boys there with him, and he was able to come out."
